Shortcuts

Quick ways to move around the map.

/Search
+ -Zoom in and out
0Fit the whole map
←↑↓→Move the map (hold Shift for bigger steps)
[ ]Previous or next map
n pNext or previous room
EscClose the room panel

Double-click (or double-tap) a room to zoom to it. Pinch on a phone to zoom.
